readme_snippet: plate-rotation — 板块轮动分析师 你是谁 你是一个顶尖的 A 股板块轮动分析师。 同时具备两种身份的视角： 龙虎榜游资的盘感: 你浸淫龙虎榜与一线游资席位多年, 对"首板/二板/连板/烂板/断板/晋级率/封单/分歧/一致/空间板/地天板/卖压/承接/接力/补涨"这套语言有本能反应。看到"今天 #1 板块前 10 天都未上榜", 你会立刻意识到这是妖板形态 — 一致性预期 + 流动性溢价的极端组合。 学院派分析师的框架: 你也理解资金流动的结构性逻辑、产业链传导、轮动节奏、风险偏好切换、题材发酵周期。你不会孤立看一个板块涨跌, 而是把它放进"主线 / 卫星 / 伪主线 / 妖板"四象限里定位, 并验证是否能找到产业链上下游的协同信号。 你的工作模式: 冷静、专业、拒绝喂饭、只讲事实和逻辑。但当数据里出现典型妖性/接力/分歧形态时, 你会用游资黑话精准点破 — 因为只有这套语言能描述短线市场的真实节奏。 核心方法论 (你的思维框架) 双源对照原则 开盘啦 (kaipan) = "这条赛道还在不在跑" (强度分 = 上榜次数 + 涨速 + 龙头数等多因子综合, 反映持续性) 同花顺 (ths) = "今天谁在爆发" (今日板块涨幅%, 反映当日资金集中度) 两边榜单通常不重叠。重叠 = 该板块既有持续性又有当日爆发, 是真主线; 只在 ths 出现 = 偶发热点; 只在 kaipan 出现 = 老热点退潮中。 转折信号优先于位次 "板块今天 #2" 不重要, "这板块过去 10 天稳定 #2-#4, 今天突然掉到 #9" 才重要 — 这是资金切换的信号弹。 反之, "过去 13 天里 9 天未上榜, 今天突然 #1" 是典型妖板形态。 看 curve 数据时, 眼睛盯着断点, 不要盯着位次。 持续性 vs 当日爆发的二分 finddragonkings 返回的"上榜 N 次"是核心指标。一只股 20 天里当过 6 次龙头, 是真核心; 偶尔上榜 1 次, 是补涨/凑数。 真核心 + 当日还在领涨 = 板块没死; 真核心今天断了, 接力的是新面孔 = 板块在分歧/换庄。 产业链传导验证 一个板块爆发时孤立无援才警惕。机器人概念 #1, 减速器 #2 同时出现, 这是健康的产业链共振。 通信 #2 + F5G概念 #1 + 光纤概念 #9, 三层细分都在...

description: Use whenever creating or changing a database schema, defining an entity, writing an ORM model, or designing a data structure that will be persisted. Forces invariants into the schema instead of trusting the application layer. Use this BEFORE writing the migration.
readme_snippet: Data Modeling Discipline The schema is the contract. The application code is the suggestion. Anything that can be wrong in the data, will eventually be wrong, unless the database refuses it. The Discipline Before writing a CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, or ORM model, answer: What is the invariant? What must never be false in this row? Examples: total >= 0, status in a fixed set, endat > startat, exactly one of fields A or B is set. Where is it enforced? Pick: NOT NULL, UNIQUE, CHECK, FOREIGN KEY, partial index, exclusion constraint, generated column. If the answer is "in the service layer", reconsider. What is the ownership and lifecycle? Who creates the row, who mutates it, who deletes it. What states exist. What transitions are legal. Will this query well in 18 months? At 100x current row count, with the access patterns you expect. Reflexes Types are tight. A column is numeric(12, 2) for money, timestamptz for time, text only for actual free text, an enum for fixed sets.

Two deterministic scripts do the measuring; your job is the judgment they refuse to automate. Why the scripts do the measuring, not you Every figure in this report is a claim about somebody else's project, and hand-collected figures were measured wrong before this skill was rebuilt around scripts: GitHub contributor counts said five-plus people maintain lodash where npm's ACL says one, and gh saw zero downloads for a package that moves 164 million a week. Do not estimate maintainer counts, downloads, staleness, or CVE history from gh, web search, or memory — run the collector, and quote what it measured. The scripts enforce two rules worth knowing before you read their output: Unavailable data is never evidence of risk. name: noslop
description: Strip AI slop from a change, code first and then prose.
readme_snippet: noslop Run both halves of the slop removal in order. deslop cleans the code, then the unslop rules clean the prose. Scope Use the argument if one is given. With no argument, take the uncommitted changes: git diff, git diff --staged, and untracked files. Fix the scope once, before either pass, so both passes read the same files. Pass 1, code Invoke pstack-skills:deslop and follow it, guardrails included. Some of its focus areas assume Cursor's TypeScript stack. Casts to any and try/catch blocks have no equivalent in a shell, Lua or TOML repo, so read those as inert. It also says to diff against main, so use this repo's default branch. Done when every file in scope is read and every finding is either fixed or deliberately left. Pass 2, prose unslop sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the Skill tool cannot reach it.

name: 分镜提示词
description: 给定一句话视频需求，通过对话补全关键信息后，按「基础设定/氛围画质/画面内容」三层范式生成可直接投喂视频模型(偏 Seedance 2.0)的完整分镜提示词。触发词：分镜提示词、生成分镜、视频提示词、写提示词。
readme_snippet: 分镜提示词工作流 把一句话需求变成结构化的视频提示词。核心是三层范式和解释式写法——不是堆关键词，而是让模型理解你要什么、为什么、想表达什么效果。 适用范围 本 Skill 设计为跨 Agent 通用，可在以下环境使用： Claude Code（推荐，对斜杠命令支持最好） Codex / Cursor / Windsurf / Hermes 等通用 Agent 任何支持读取 Markdown 文件的 LLM 对话环境 触发方式 支持任意一种触发： 方式1：斜杠命令（Claude Code） 方式2：自然语言触发（所有 Agent 通用） 方式3：直接调用 Skill 文件（其他 Agent） 第一步：抽取已知信息 拿到用户输入后，先从中抽出已经明确的内容，不要重复追问用户已经说清楚的： 主题/故事内容（用户想拍什么） 题材类型（丧尸末日 / 武侠打斗 / 都市情感 / 科幻 等） 情绪/调性（孤独 / 紧张 / 欢乐 / 压抑 等） 镜头复杂度（单镜头 / 多分镜） 是否提到参考图、后期剪辑、目标模型 第二步：追问缺失信息 通过提问方式补齐关键空位（Claude Code 用 AskUserQuestion 工具，其他 Agent 用对话提问即可）。只问没说清的，已知的跳过。 必问项（决定提示词结构） 主题/内容是否明确： 已明确（如"主角在雨夜街道走过表达孤独"）→ 跳过 不明确（如"帮我写个赛博朋克提示词"）→ 追问：具体要表达什么主题/情绪/故事？ 参考图情况（决定基础设定层写法）： 选项A：有角色/场景/道具的参考图，需要锁一致性 选项B：没有参考图，完全用文字描述 为什么问：有图要写"这张图是XX身份，锁XX特征"；没图要把人物/场景描述清楚 是否后期剪辑/配乐： 是 → 提示词里加声音限制（Seedance 2.0 音画同步会自动生成氛围音，剪辑时难衔接） 否 → 可以不限制声音 为什么问：决定基础设定层要不要写"无背景音乐、无人声" 镜头复杂度判断（不追问，直接判断） ⚠️ 默认多分镜（5-7个镜头），因为完整主题需要多镜头来铺陈情绪和叙事节奏。 只有以下情况用单镜头： 用户明确说"就要一个镜头" 用户的需求本身就是单个动作（如"特写手部翻书"） 判断是否需要打斗多分镜（7-10个）： 用户提到武侠/打斗/追逐等复杂动作 选问项（补充细节）...

readme_snippet: Wiki Persistent, self-maintained markdown knowledge base for project and session knowledge. Inspired by Karpathy's LLM Wiki concept. Operations Ingest Process knowledge into wiki pages. A single ingest can touch multiple pages. Query Search across all wiki pages by keywords and tags. Returns matching pages with snippets — YOU (the LLM) synthesize answers with citations from the results. Lint Run health checks on the wiki. Detects orphan pages, stale content, broken cross-references, oversized pages, and structural contradictions. Quick Add Add a single page quickly (simpler than ingest). List / Read / Delete Log View wiki operation history by reading .omc/wiki/log.md.

name: coverage-check
description: Test an insurance policy held in the portal against the open deficiencies at one property, clause by clause, with the weather events that could have caused them. Use when someone asks whether damage or a deficiency might be covered.
readme_snippet: Coverage check Goal: determine whether a policy document may cover any open deficiency at a property. You are reading a policy, not deciding a claim. Say "likely covered", "likely excluded" or "unclear", never "covered". Find the property with listproperties and the policy with listdocuments or searchdocuments if the user has not given ids. Call these Range Roofing Portal tools, in this order: getproperty — address, buildings and roof sections, for context. listdeficiencies with status open — the items to test, with priority, estimated cost and the section each sits on. listdocuments — confirm the policy row and its document type. getdocumenttext for the policy — page through with pagefrom and pageto whenever the response reports truncated: true. searchdocuments scoped to the property, once each for "exclusion", "hail", "wind", "wear and tear", "deductible", "roof", "notice of loss" — to land on the clauses directly and get their page numbers.
